name: Cross-Pack Coverage Assessment
description: Compare explicit date, geography, language and topic scope against pinned source-pack runs.
questions: Which ${topic} evidence is observed for ${geography}, ${language}, and ${date_window}?
Which scope cells have empty successful searches, unavailable sources, or no attempt?
Which changes reflect recovered evidence rather than changed scope, pack versions, or credentials?
success_criteria: Pin historical pack versions and committed source-pack run receipts
Cite exact document revisions for observed cells
State the assessed denominator and missingness reasons without claiming exhaustive recall
report_outline: Empty, unavailable, unattempted, and out-of-scope cells
Changes across runs, source limitations, and next actions
